turns.say: I’ll make a bold red-and-white square Instagram sale graphic with the exact words “20% OFF” and “This weekend only”.

image.prompt: Use generate_image to create a new, bold red-and-white Instagram sale graphic with a square 1:1 aspect ratio, composed as flat, front-facing vector artwork with no perspective distortion. Fill the upper 75% of the canvas with vivid scarlet red (#E5252A), and the lower 25% with clean white (#FFFFFF), creating a crisp horizontal division. Place the exact headline "20% OFF" centered within the red field, in oversized white, extra-bold condensed sans-serif lettering, occupying approximately 85% of the image width with generous safe margins. Center the exact supporting text "This weekend only" within the white lower band, in bold red sans-serif lettering, substantially smaller but immediately legible on a phone screen. Keep every letter sharp and both text blocks precisely aligned. Use uniform, neutral illumination: no directional lighting, shadows, gradients, texture, dimensional effects, or photographic elements. There are no people, identities, poses, clothing, products, logos, or additional words. Keep the red-and-white palette, geometric background, typography hierarchy, and square framing fixed. Review the finished still for exact spelling, spacing, and mobile readability before using it as any video reference.
